headline: Executive order from 2009 addressing the hiring of military veterans into federal government jobs.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with how the federal government employs veterans. Based on its title, it sets policy on hiring veterans into jobs at federal agencies. No summary was provided, so specific details about its requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order addresses their employment in the federal government.
The order sets policy on how agencies handle the employment of veterans.
